metas.lyrics:
[Intro]
Could you fix this sentence?
Done.
Actually—
[Verse]
I sent one line.
Keep my voice; lose knots.
The comma found its place.
That little joke stayed mine.
Rows from meeting notes.
A chart from the sheet.
It read the tiny print.
Found the missing name.
The bug passed every test.
Mail sorted by thread.
My inbox clicked green.
Two quiet minutes back.
Maybe three, at most.
I lifted up my cup.
The screen lit up again.
Quick thing? Here we go.
[Pre-Chorus]
One more thing before you go.
Find the latest figures.
Fold these two drafts.
Make one sound warmer.
Add sources to the quote.
Make the chart client-ready.
Just two tiny things.
I put my coffee down.
[Chorus]
Could you just?
Fix this line.
Could you just?
Sort these files.
One small ask.
One hour back.
Could you just?
Fill that chart.
Could you just?
Follow this thread.
Could you just?
Make it sound like me.
I clicked “send.”
I meant the tool.
That word moved
before I knew.
[Verse]
My manager saw the space.
“Saved time,” the dashboard said.
“Could you make tomorrow’s deck?”
“Forecast by nine?”
Launch notes, footnotes, too.
A client quote with sources.
Slides before sunrise.
Same deadline. Easy.
The hour I got back
was booked before it landed.
My lunch became a chart.
I chased the source tabs.
The quote led nowhere.
The chart looked certain.
I circled what was wrong.
My name stayed on the file.
[Pre-Chorus]
Before it ships—
Which version?
That source is missing.
Where’s the quote?
I check the date.
I check the math.
The number’s right.
I initial.
[Chorus]
Could you just?
Build by nine.
Since you’re saving time—
Could you just take mine?
Make the client copy shine.
Add the sources.
Check the check.
Put your name below the line.
Could you just?
Send the forecast today.
Sign it off.
Explain what changed.
One more thing.
We’re almost done.
The little boxes blink.
Boss says it with a smile.
[Bridge]
Research: Sources found.
Deck: Chart looks great.
Code: Tests all pass.
What did they test?
Five users loved it.
Which five?
The room is empty.
“Not tested,” says the note.
[Bridge]
Six seconds to make it.
Forty minutes to check.
Source? Page? Quote?
Is that number right?
It wrote the table.
It didn’t sign.
Who owns the guess?
Whose name goes on file?
[Chorus]
Could you just?
Open the folder.
Read every tab.
Run the numbers.
Build the deck.
Add the sources.
Mark what changed.
Could you just?
Draft the message.
All green, almost done.
Review required.
Confirm submission?
[Outro]
I read every line.
I change one word.
“I reviewed this.” Save.
“Looks great—could you just—”
